title: Proper perfect direct image of a perfect object is compact
statement: Let X and Y be Noetherian schemes with chosen derived categories and derived categories on every open, and let f : X → Y be proper with stalk maps of finite Tor dimension. Given a functor R from the quasi-coherent derived category of X to that of Y and an isomorphism comparing R with derived direct image, every perfect object P on X is sent by R to a compact object on Y (with the canonical universe-u coproduct instances).

proof.text: For each stalk use lem-weil-pbc-tor-symmetry to identify Tor'(M,N) with Tor'(N,M). Apply NatTrans.leftDerived to tensorLeftIsoTensorRight M to identify Tor(M,N) with Tor'(N,M). Compose the two isomorphisms and transport the given vanishing, obtaining HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f without changing its pointwise bounds.

Apply lem-pc-perfect-noetherian-cohomology to P to obtain bounded coherent cohomology. For each cohomology sheaf, pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth gives quasi-coherence and finite type, and lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed makes its nonzero-stalk locus closed. Use the vanishingIdeal reduced closed subscheme of this locus as the explicit proper-support witness: its closed immersion composed with the proper f is proper.

Apply lem-pc-perfect-relative-finite-tor with the converted stalkwise condition and hP. Properness supplies local finite type and Noetherian X supplies compactness. Apply lem-pc-bounded-coherent-finite-tor-proper-pushforward-perfect, whose independent source and target derived universes match wX and wY, to the bounds, coherence, support witnesses and relative Tor dimension. This gives perfection of the ambient derived direct image of P.

Evaluate eR on P and map this isomorphism through derived restriction to each open in the perfect cover of the direct image. Compose with its strictly perfect representative isomorphism to obtain Scheme.IsPerfect Y (R.obj P). Apply lem-pc-perfect-object-compact with the canonical derivedQCohDirectSums Y coproduct instance.

lean.statement:
theorem properPerfect_transport_compact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hTor : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) (i : ℕ), n < i →
        IsZero (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) i).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)))).obj N))
    (R : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (eR : R ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ≅
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hP : Scheme.IsPerfect X P.1) :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y
    IsCompactObject (R.obj P)
